Interface BeanResolutionTracer.Resolution

Enclosing interface:
BeanResolutionTracer
public static interface BeanResolutionTracer.Resolution
A read-only view of a bean resolution in progress, passed to the callbacks of a tracer. It reflects the resolution at the time of the callback and must only be used during the callback.

The identity of a resolution is not stable: the callbacks of a single creation may receive different instances, as the context copies a resolution in progress, for example to create a scoped bean. A tracer links a creation to the creation it is nested in with getBeansInCreation() or its own per thread stack, not with the identity of the resolution.

Since:
5.3.0

      The definitions of the beans being created in this resolution, from the outermost to the innermost, the innermost being the bean whose dependencies are being resolved. A bean created for an injection point of another bean is nested in it. Beans that a bean looks up programmatically while it is created are resolved in another resolution and are not included.
